rules.rationale: A low HEART score predicts a low rate of 30-day MACE.
rules.citation: Level B recommendations: In adult patients without evidence of ST-elevation [SNOMED: 164931005] ACS [SNOMED: 394659003], the History, ECG [SNOMED: 29303009], Age, Risk factors [SNOMED: 80943009], Troponin [SNOMED: 102680009] (HEART [SNOMED: 80891009]) score [SNOMED: 278061009] can be used as a clinical prediction instrument [SNOMED: 57134006] for risk stratification. A low score [SNOMED: 278061009] (<=3) predicts 30-day MACE miss rate within a range of 0% to 2%.

rules.rationale: Clinical judgment alone achieves ~91-96% sensitivity for MACE, but falls short of the >98% threshold unless combined with objective biomarkers and ECG.
rules.citation: Clinical Judgment [SNOMED: 61254005]: Unstructured physician gestalt alone achieves ~91-96% sensitivity [SNOMED: 35209006] for MACE, falling short of the required >98% sensitivity [SNOMED: 35209006] threshold [SNOMED: 246510005] unless combined [SNOMED: 89780004] with objective cardiac [SNOMED: 80891009] biomarkers and ECG [SNOMED: 29303009].
